title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Commercial Flows)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for FPSO Specialist Commercial Flows, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Purchase and Sales of commercial goods
  • Inventory management
  • Transportation flows

The FPSO Specialist Commercial flows:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes.

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements : enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD
  • BOLD implementations in new countries : act as a referent for CORE processes and data related to his scope. Find the balance between local needs and Group requirements
  • Innovation: support initiatives integrated with BOLD linked to innovation (analytics, automation, switch to paperless)

The FPSO Specialist Commercial flows will work for BOLD implementation in new countries, concretely in Brazil rollout (BORA Project), in charge of group of processes related to Commercial flows, as well as being responsible for scope and deadlines.

This role requires close relationship with our Business partners, other members of the Program, especially with, EPSO (for execution), IPSO (for Industry) and hand-in- hand collaboration with our DT&A departments and Front Office implementation team.

On top of his/her activities related to Global Finance Transformation, the FPSO Specialist Senior Commercial flow will help the group to switch to other transformation initiative (such as Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Block chain) by providing his/her functional expertise.

Qualifications

Experience

3/5 years of strong operational experience ideally.

The candidate will have several or more of the below items:

  • Experience from a Finance Consulting or Technology Consulting firm
  • Participation in Finance transformation project either as an internal or as an external resource
  • Experience in working in project mode and ability to perform in various roles from individual contributor to a leadership role
  • Experience in Finance Transformation projects, , specially focusing in Commercial flows areas
  • Working experience in companies dedicated to agriculture or commodity business
  • Experience in working in project mode
  • Experience in international environments
  • Experience in process design and implementation in an IT tool
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment
  • Experience and expertise on SAP S/4 for SD and or FI modules

Other skills (Computer Skills, etc)

  • Fundamental understanding of core accounting and finance processes is required.
  • Strong ability to gather & analyze information, define problems and form a plan of action.
  • Evident ability to analyze and challenge workflows, being analytical and synthetic.
  • Exceptional organizational ability with a very strong attention to detail.
  • Must be able to work independently and take ownership of this role.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work under time pressure and result oriented.

Languages:

  • English (fluent)

Academics

  • Finance/Accounting and/or

Highridge Medical creates the world’s most innovative spinal solutions across the spectrum from Motion Preservation to MIS to Bone Healing to Core Spine. Working at Highridge Medical is not just work. Life at Highridge Medical is purpose driven. Every day, you have the privilege of using your talents to demonstrate Confidence in your work and restore Confidence for our patients. Confidence that moves.

The Regulatory and Quality Affairs Manager will oversee quality assurance and regulatory compliance for Highridge Medical’s operation in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring local alignment with global regulations and standards and for ensuring corporate alignment with Brazilian regulations and standards. This role will collaborate with cross-functional teams locally and globally to maintain product quality, manage regulatory submissions, and support market access.

Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure Compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements per ANVISA standards for product registration, licensing, and post-market Surveillance.
  • Prepare, submit, and manage regulatory dossiers for product approvals, renewals, and significant changes in Brazil.
  • Act as primary point of contact for Latin American distributors who are building dossiers to submit for approvals, renewals, and significant changes in their markets.
  • Monitor changes in Brazilian and Latin American regulations and advise on their impact to company operations.
  • Liase with ANVISA and other regulatory bodies as the primary point of contact, and Technical Responsible person, in Brazil.
  • Work with US based team members to develop global procedures that appropriately capture Brazilian requirements.
  • Advise local and corporate leadership on regulatory and quality strategies for market expansion in Brazil and other Latin American markets.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Quality Assurance:

  • Maintain and improve the local Quality Management System in accordance with Brazilian GMP and international standards.
  • Partner with corporate quality and regulatory teams to ensure global alignment of policies and procedures.
  • Conduct internal and external audits to ensure compliance with Quality Standards.
  • Manage Non-Conformances (NCs) and Corrective Action/Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to resolve quality issues for the Brazilian site.
  • Support global NCs and CAPAs to resolve quality issues which impact Brazil and Latin American markets.
  • Ensure proper documentation and record keeping for quality and regulatory processes both within the Brazilian site and at any 3rd party logistics providers in Brazil.
  • Implement Vigilance systems to track product performance on the Brazilian Market.
  • Organize and run Brazilian Management Review meetings.
  • Provide training to local staff on regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Host ANVISA for any audits that may need to take place at the Brazilian site.

Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills, and abilities)

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal); Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, international teams, company leadership, distributors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Working knowledge of global regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Ability to lead a team, influence others, and handle increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Understands the overall business environment, the orthopedic industry, and the marketplace. Direct experience with spinal implant companies is a plus.
  • Ability to identify and assess business risks to develop Regulatory strategy
  • Ability to manage/supervise employees and consultants.
  • Excellent project management and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills.

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (e.g. life sciences, engineering, pharmacy, or related discipline).
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • 6-8 years of experience required in a Regulatory and Quality Affairs capacity.
  • Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) preferred
  • Experience in the areas implantable medical device regulatory and quality affairs is strongly preferred.
  • A combination of education and experience may be considered

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15%

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Statistics Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with a Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field to join our cutting-edge AI team. In this role, you will contribute to the development, training, and fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) by applying statistical methods, data analysis, and model evaluation techniques. Your expertise will directly impact the accuracy, performance, and robustness of advanced AI systems deployed for real-world applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement statistical frameworks for the preparation, analysis, and quality assessment of large-scale datasets used in training LLMs.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to detect biases, data inconsistencies, and anomalies in training corpora.
  • Collaborate closely with AI researchers and engineers to develop data annotation guidelines and evaluation protocols.
  • Apply advanced statistical methods to assess model outputs and guide iterative training improvements.
  • Develop and maintain automated tools for data preprocessing, labeling, sampling, and quality control in LLM pipelines.
  • Conduct rigorous hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and performance benchmarking of LLMs across various tasks.
  • Interpret model behaviors using statistical insights and provide actionable recommendations for model fine-tuning.
  • Document methodologies, maintain reproducible workflows, and contribute to technical publications.

Key Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science (with strong statistics focus), or related quantitative field.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, probability theory, and experimental design.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale datasets, data cleaning, feature engineering, and statistical analysis tools.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Julia, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, or statsmodels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and understanding of LLM architectures (transformers, attention mechanisms).
  • Experience with annotation tools and data labeling processes is a plus.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.

Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.

Qualifications:

  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

Vaga:

Supervisor Regional PR(Brasil e Paraguai).

Descrição da Vaga

  • Liderar e motivar a equipe de vendas, incentivando um ambiente colaborativo e focado em resultados;
  • Estruturar e executar o planejamento estratégico de vendas, estabelecendo metas, indicadores e ações para alcançar os objetivos definidos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar relatórios de performance, avaliando métricas e resultados para garantir o atingimento das metas e impulsionar o crescimento da equipe;
  • Trabalhar em proximidade com o time, oferecendo suporte, orientação e identificando oportunidades de capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Realizar visitas presenciais a clientes, compreendendo suas demandas, oferecendo soluções personalizadas e fortalecendo o relacionamento comercial;
  • Monitorar constantemente o mercado, a concorrência e as tendências, sugerindo ajustes no plano de vendas para manter a competitividade da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Agronomia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência sólida com fertilizantes, especialmente formulações NPK;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação nos territórios de Paraná (Brasil) e Paraguai ;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado e prático das principais culturas agrícolas da região;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes de vendas no setor Agro;
  • Forte capacidade em planejamento estratégico de vendas e desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance;
  • Domínio de Excel em nível intermediário , incluindo criação de planilhas, uso de funções, tabelas dinâmicas e elaboração de gráficos analíticos.

title: Consultor(a) Pleno de Inovação - Rio de Janeiro, RJ
description:
Quer trabalhar numa consultoria de inovação que há 18 anos atua junto às empresas mais inovadoras do Brasil?

Quer trabalhar em projetos com players globais e ajudar a transformar essas organizações?

Então, seu lugar é aqui na Innoscience.

Nascemos com o propósito de transformar o mundo por meio da inovação e fazemos isso apoiando grandes empresas a usarem todo o seu potencial com foco na geração de resultados.

Assessoramos conselheiros, diretores e gerentes para entender a nova economia e a revolução digital, criar a estratégia, cultura e processos adequados para fomentar a inovação.

Realizamos projetos com as áreas de inovação, marketing, RH, estratégia, projetos, pesquisa e desenvolvimento e as próprias unidades de negócios de nossos clientes.

Oferecemos um ambiente informal, intenso, exigente e diverso com a possibilidade de participar ativamente de projetos desafiadores de empresas referência em seus segmentos e impactar positivamente a sociedade.

Sobre a vaga:

O(A) consultor(a) pleno de inovação na Innoscience atuará de forma estratégica e dinâmica, liderando projetos de inovação aberta que conectam grandes empresas e startups. A rotina inclui gestão de múltiplos projetos, facilitação de workshops, relacionamento com stakeholders e análise de resultados para geração de impacto. É esperado que o(a) consultor(a) trabalhe com autonomia e visão crítica, propondo soluções criativas e promovendo a cultura de inovação dentro das organizações atendidas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Gestão e Acompanhamento de Projetos de Inovação Aberta: Gerenciar e acompanhar diretamente projetos piloto e rollout entre grandes empresas (clientes da Innoscience) e startups, assegurando a execução eficiente e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos desde o início até a conclusão. 

Gerenciamento de Relacionamentos: Estabelecer e manter relações produtivas entre as partes interessadas das grandes empresas e startups, agindo como um ponto de ligação para resolver questões e promover uma comunicação clara. 

Monitoramento e Avaliação: Acompanhar o progresso dos projetos piloto e de rollout, utilizando indicadores de desempenho para avaliar os resultados e identificar oportunidades de melhoria. 

Gerenciamento de Riscos e Soluções: Proativamente identificar riscos potenciais nos projetos piloto e rollout e trabalhar em soluções criativas junto ao cliente Innoscience e startups para mitigá-los, garantindo o mínimo de interrupções no progresso do projeto. 

Facilitação da aplicação da Metodologia Innoscience: Implementar e promover a metodologia da Innoscience dentro dos projetos para acelerar a entrega de resultados e adaptar-se rapidamente a novas informações ou mudanças de mercado. 

Condução de Workshops, Rituais e Dinâmicas de Trabalho: Planejar e conduzir workshops e dinâmicas de trabalho para estruturação do trabalho e alinhamento entre as equipes de grandes empresas e startups, promovendo um ambiente de cocriação e pensamento crítico. 

Capacitação e Suporte às Equipes: Fornecer suporte e treinamento contínuo para as equipes envolvidas, assegurando que possuam as habilidades necessárias para executar os projetos piloto com sucesso. 

Gestão de Expectativas: Gerenciar as expectativas de todas as partes interessadas, garantindo alinhamento e satisfação com os resultados dos projetos piloto e de rollout. 

Análise dos Resultados e Compartilhamento de Aprendizados: Suportar os times dos Desafios na análise e captura dos resultados dos experimentos, orientando a estruturação do Business Case e planejamento de rollout, bem como a análise de lições aprendidas e melhores práticas em cada projeto, compartilhando conhecimentos para aprimorar futuros projetos de inovação aberta. 

Promoção da Cultura de Inovação: Contribuir para a criação e manutenção de uma cultura de inovação dentro das organizações participantes, incentivando a experimentação e a adoção de novas ideias e tecnologias. "

Informações sobre a vaga:

Forma de contratação: PJ

Modelo: Híbrido, com atuação presencial no Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Benefícios e Oportunidades na Innoscience:

PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: Incentivo financeiro baseado no desempenho da empresa e individual, promovendo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais.

Plano de Carreira em Y: Oferecemos duas trajetórias de evolução profissional: técnica ou liderança. Nosso plano é baseado em avaliações 360º, feedbacks e acompanhamento do plano de desenvolvimento individual.

Empresas Inovadoras: Parceria com as empresas mais inovadoras do Brasil, abrangendo diversos setores e promovendo um impacto significativo.

Acesso a Tecnologia de IA Generativa: Trabalhe com as mais avançadas tecnologias de inteligência artificial generativa, impulsionando soluções inovadoras para nossos clientes.

Cultura de Alto Desempenho: Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador que valoriza a excelência e a superação de resultados.

Práticas de Gestão de Pessoas: Adotamos práticas de gestão baseadas nas teorias mais avançadas da psicologia organizacional, focadas no desenvolvimento e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Title: Sales & Operations Lead

Location: Brazil

Employment type: Full-time

About the Role

We are expanding our presence in Brazil and seeking a Sales & Operations Lead to ensure every customer order and shipment runs smoothly, from confirmation to delivery. This is a hands-on role where you will own the order-to-cash cycle, drive continuous improvements, and act as the connector between Sales, Finance, Logistics partners, and customers.

This is an exciting chance to join a fast-growing, international organization where your work directly impacts growth and customer success.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage inbound & outbound logistics , ensuring on-time and in-full delivery.
  • Own the order-to-cash cycle : processing orders, maintaining accurate records, and overseeing invoicing.
  • Align demand, supply, and inventory with sales forecasts.
  • Serve as the daily link between Sales, Finance (external back-office), logistics partners, and customers.
  • Support billing, collections, and proactive customer communications.
  • Report weekly KPIs (delivery performance, AR overdue, issue resolution).
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements for scalability.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–7+ years in sales operations, logistics coordination, or customer operations in a B2B setting.
  • Hands-on experience managing licensed import partners and 3PL providers.
  • Strong knowledge of electronic invoicing and commercial documentation in Brazil.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and comfort with CRM/partner portals.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • A customer-first mindset, strong attention to detail, and ability to stay calm under pressure.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in industrial chemicals, lubricants, or distribution.
  • Knowledge of foreign-trade documentation and warehouse cycles.
  • Basic process-improvement skills.

What We Offer

  • A chance to be a key player in building our Brazilian operations.
  • The autonomy and responsibility of a lean, fast-paced team.
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a future-proof industry.

title: MEIO OFICIAL DE MANUTENÇÃO GUARULHOS
description:
NOME DO CARGO: Meio Oficial de Manutenção Civil

RESUMO DA FUNÇÃO:

Auxilia nas atividades de manutenção civil, colaborando com a equipe técnica na realização de reparos, organização do ambiente e cumprimento de normas de segurança.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Auxiliar na execução de serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em estruturas civis.
  • Apoiar nos reparos em alvenaria, pintura, instalações elétricas e hidráulicas.
  • Preparar ferramentas e materiais para as atividades de manutenção.
  • Executar tarefas simples sob supervisão, como limpeza de áreas de trabalho.
  • Participar de inspeções e relatar necessidades de reparo.

REQUISITOS:

  • Obrigatório: Ensino médio completo. Conhecimento básico sobre ferramentas e materiais utilizados na manutenção civil. Disposição para aprender e se desenvolver na área.
  • Diferenciais: Formação técnica em Edificações ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência prévia em manutenção civil ou construção.

CONDIÇÕES DE TRABALHO:

  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 07h00 às 16h48
  • Modelo: Presencial
  • Local: Jardim Santo Afonso, Guarulhos - SP
  • Faixa salarial: R$ 2.855,11 + 30% de periculosidade (CLT)
  • Benefícios: Vale Transporte, Assistência médica, assistência odontológica e seguro de vida.

title: Remote Physics Expert (PhD) - 34878
description:
Join Turing as a Physics Expert (PhD, Remote) and help shape how the world’s most advanced AI models reason about physics. Work on cutting-edge projects with top AI labs while earning upto $150/hr, fully remote, with flexible weekly hours.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

Role Overview:

We are seeking PhD-level Physics experts to contribute to cutting-edge AI research. As a Physics Expert – AI Trainer, you’ll design challenging problems, evaluate model outputs, and provide expert feedback to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs).

This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30 hours per week).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and solve advanced physics problems across mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum theory, and related domains.
  • Evaluate AI-generated solutions for scientific rigor, correctness, and clarity.
  • Provide structured, expert-level feedback that identifies model strengths, weaknesses, and misconceptions.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to refine evaluation benchmarks and improve training workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation of physics-focused datasets that shape the frontier of AI performance.

Key Qualifications:

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or closely related fields.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with clear reasoning.
  • Excellent written communication; able to explain advanced concepts simply and precisely.
  • Independent, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a remote research environment.
  • Reliable technical setup (computer + internet).

Why Join Turing?

  • Impact: Your expertise will directly influence how the world’s most advanced AI systems understand and reason about physics.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first role with weekly hour options tailored to your schedule.
  • Collaboration: Work alongside global experts and leading AI labs.
  • Career Growth: Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI research and future-proof your career at the intersection of physics and artificial intelligence.

Engagement Details:

  • Compensation: $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration: 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours: Up to 30 hrs/week.
  • Time Zone: 2–5 hrs/day overlap with UTC-8 (America/Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.

Selection: Task-based assessment for shortlisted candidates → contract offer.

title: Assistente Fiscal
description:
AVISO: "A TMF Group em nenhum momento solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento como parte do nosso processo seletivo, e sempre contatamos nossos candidatos via contas e plataformas corporativas. Se você foi abordado e com solicitação de pagamento, trata-se de uma fraude. Por favor, verifique se a vaga a qual você está interessado, está publicada em nosso site."

SOBRE A TMF GROUP

A TMF Group ajuda seus clientes a operar internacionalmente e 'pertencer' a qualquer lugar do mundo. Nosso trabalho inclui apoiar empresas de todos os tamanhos com serviços como RH e Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Secretariado Corporativo, Governança Global e Administração e Serviços Fiduciários para Finanças Estruturadas, Private Equity e Investimentos Imobiliários. Em 2022 a TMF Group adquiriu a Paraty Capital, uma plataforma brasileira de administração de fundos com foco em fundos de Private Equity, infraestrutura e Venture Capital.

SOBRE O SEU PERFIL

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com escrituração fiscal e análise de retenções.

Diferenciais:

  • Excel intermediário;

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

  • Realizar a escrituração fiscal de documentos, garantindo a correta classificação e registro das operações;
  • Apurar retenções tributárias (INSS, IRRF, CSRF, ISS, entre outros);
  • Emitir e revisar documentos fiscais;
  • Manter atualizadas as informações fiscais nos sistemas ERP e planilhas de controle.

O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Modelo Hibrido (02 dias presencial - Alphaville);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Parcerias de Educação;
  • Credencial Plena - SESC
  • Ajuda de Custo Home-office;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Plataforma de Idiomas Online.

O QUE TEMOS

Impacto Internacional

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.

Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.

Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.

  • Sendo uma instituição com oportunidades iguais, TMF Group visa diversidade buscando contratar e desenvolver profissionais talentosos, independentemente de sua idade, raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, religião e educação. Acreditamos que as diferentes historias, origens, e experiências multiculturais de nossos colaboradores são um poderoso elemento para a criação de um ambiente inclusivo e diversificado onde todos se sintam à vontade em demonstrar sua personalidade única e autentica no trabalho. Trabalhamos fortemente para conseguir criar um ambiente de trabalho que reflita as comunidades que servimos e perspectivas únicas que nossa diversa equipe traz para a nossa companhia e clientes.

title: Programador(a) Back-End - Unity/C#
description:
Local: Híbrido (Localidade Zona Oeste de São Paulo).

Contrato: CLT

Sobre a Oportunidade

Você irá atuar no desenvolvimento Back-End de soluções tecnológicas voltadas para o auxílio à navegação aquaviária, em um projeto inovador com colaboração internacional. Seu foco será na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos e escaláveis, responsáveis pelo processamento de dados em tempo real, integração com módulos de geolocalização (GIS), lógica de negócio e comunicação com APIs e bancos de dados. A tecnologia será aplicada em ferramentas utilizadas por profissionais como práticos, operadores de empurradores e comboios fluviais, com o objetivo de melhorar a precisão, segurança e eficiência das operações nos rios e portos.

Neste papel, você fará parte de um time multidisciplinar e altamente técnico, desenvolvendo soluções baseadas em Unity e C#, com forte atuação no Back-End, incluindo suporte à análise de dados, controle de fluxos e integração entre sistemas. O projeto é conduzido com metodologias ágeis (Scrum), gestão de tarefas via ClickUp e versionamento de código com GitHub

Suas responsabilidades

  • Participar da revisão metodológica e na especificação de dados de entrada.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar algoritmos e software para processamento de dados.
  • Criar e manter APIs e interfaces de dados para integração entre sistemas.
  • Apoiar na integração de módulos, análise de dados e auto-monitoramento .
  • Contribuir na implementação em nível de sistema .
  • Participar do projeto e execução de casos de uso em cenários de simulação .
  • Realizar validação em ambiente relevante , garantindo estabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em equipe ágil (Scrum), com foco em entregas de qualidade.

O que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Back-End .

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Finance)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for Financial Specialist, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Payment flow (incl. integration with other systems), cash income flows and bank statement
  • Controlling
  • Accounting, fixed assets and months end closing
  • Integration with Consolidation and Reporting

The Financial Specialist:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements : enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD
  • BOLD implementations in new countries : act as a referent for CORE processes and data related to his scope. Find the balance between local needs and Group requirements

A Navigandi , fundada em 2019 como spin-off do Laboratório Tanque de Provas Numérico da USP (TPN-USP), é uma empresa especializada no desenvolvimento de tecnologias e equipamentos de auxílio à navegação .

title: Especialista Engenharia Clínica
description:
Sobre REDE SANTA CATARINA

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade

Atribuições:

- Responsável pelo acompanhamento das ações desenvolvidas na engenharia corporativa no que tange aos equipamentos médicos, junto as unidades hospitalares, desde a elaboração, atualização e desenvolvimento de descritivos de procedimentos que vão desde a aquisição de tecnologias, instalação, treinamento de usuário, passando pelas atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva, preditiva, calibração.

- Auxiliar na formulação de projetos destinados a modernização e acompanhamento de ativos, promovendo a avaliação de desempenho e custos das tecnologias médicas, e obsolescência, seguindo os procedimentos e rotinas padronizados, garantindo a aplicação correta e segura da tecnologia, mitigando riscos e promovendo a redução de custos

- Elaborar e atualizar os processos e procedimentos padronizados, de acordo com as exigências dos fabricantes, normatização e legislação, aplicados na unidade hospitalar, de maneira a garantir pleno funcionamento dos equipamentos médicos, além de inspeções de manutenção preventiva dos equipamentos;

-Avaliar as novas tecnologias e existentes no mercado e auxiliar na elaboração descritivos, especificando equipamentos e tecnologias a serem adquiridos, analisando tecnicamente a qualidade e garantindo o melhor custo benefício;

- Promover atualização das equipes de manutenção por meio de treinamentos de aplicação adequada e segura dos equipamentos médicos;

- Orientar os usuários dos equipamentos médicos no manuseio correto das tecnologias, a fim de minimizar a possibilidade de erros operacionais e danos, além do melhor rendimento dos equipamentos e incremento da sua vida útil com treinamentos junto aos fabricantes;

- Acompanhar, controlar e dinamizar os contratos de manutenção preventiva/corretiva e da aquisição de peças, inclusive com sua especificação;

- Responsável pela elaboração, desenvolvimento e aplicação do Book Técnico (EC e Infra)

- Acompanhar a performance de ativos, através da análise de histórico e dos processos de manutenção e peças, com desenvolvimento de indicadores de performance;

- Garantir a maior disponibilidade dos equipamentos médicos, através da monitoração de indicadores, a fim permitir a maximização de sua utilização e contribuindo para aos resultados propostos no orçamento de planejamento e crescimento da Rede SC

Requisitos:

- Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia;

- Especialização Engenharia Clínica;

- Conhecimento em Excel, Power BI e Autocad;

- Conhecimento em RDC50; NBR9050;

- Conhecimento amplo em tecnologias médicas e clínicas;

- Conhecimento gestão da manutenção.

“A Rede Santa Catarina respeita, promove e apoia a inclusão. Nossas vagas são abertas para atrair talentos diversos, valorizando todas as características independentemente de deficiência, raça, etnia, gênero, idade, orientação sexual ou religião.”

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities:

1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities:

1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies/Requirements:

1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth

title: Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality medical and scientific content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and communicate clinical and biomedical information.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and medically sound content, including:

  • Clinical and scientific explanations of medical topics
  • Research summaries, clinical abstracts, and literature reviews
  • Patient education materials
  • Medical problem sets, case studies, and evidence-based Q&A
  • Regulatory, pharmacological, or public health-focused content (as applicable)

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine medical-related model outputs
  • Identify and address conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build diverse datasets across medical and healthcare domains (e.g., anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, public health, epidemiology, evidence-based medicine)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, comprehension, and communication of healthcare content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related healthcare/clinical discipline
  • (Exceptional candidates with professional degrees such as MD, DO, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent clinical experience will be considered)
  • Strong background in medical/scientific writing, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and accurately
  • Experience with literature review, evidence synthesis, or regulatory writing is a plus
  • Familiarity with scientific publishing standards, citation practices, and biomedical databases (e.g., PubMed, Cochrane)

Additional Requirement:

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

This assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

title: Remote Physics Research Scientist (PhD) - 34878
description:
Turing is hiring Physics Research Scientists (PhD, Remote) to test and improve how advanced AI models handle reasoning and problem-solving in physics. Work with top AI labs, contribute to frontier benchmarks, and earn upto $150/hr on a flexible, remote schedule.

Role Overview:

We are seeking PhD-level Physics researchers to rigorously test the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). In this role, you’ll create physics problems, analyze model responses, and identify logical gaps to help improve AI’s conceptual understanding and structured problem-solving.

This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and evaluate challenging physics problems to test AI reasoning.
  • Analyze AI-generated solutions for logic, rigor, and step-by-step clarity.
  • Provide detailed, constructive feedback that highlights gaps in reasoning.
  • Contribute to the development of benchmarks that measure model performance on abstract and multi-step tasks.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine methodologies for testing AI reasoning.

Must-have Qualifications:

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or related fields.
  • Strong ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with structured reasoning.
  • Skilled communicator, able to explain logic and critique clearly in writing.
  • Independent, self-motivated, and comfortable in a remote setting.
  • Reliable computer and internet setup.

Why Join Turing?

  • Impact: Help define how AI models reason about abstract, scientific problems.
  • Prestige: Work with leading AI labs shaping the future of reasoning systems.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first, with weekly hour options.
  • Career Growth: Gain experience at the intersection of AI and physics research.

Contract & Selection Process:

  • Compensation: $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration: 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours: Up to 30 hrs/week.
  • Time Zone: 2–5 hrs/day overlap with UTC-8 (America/Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal.

Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.

Atuar como Analista na gestão contratual, analisando pleitos de fornecedores sob aspectos técnicos e jurídicos, conduzindo negociações e assegurando cumprimento de normas e prazos. Contribuindo para a redução de riscos e custos. Apoia a gestão com relatórios, indicadores e suporte estratégico à tomada de decisão.

title: Human Resource Supervisor
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for human resources management of the company in the Brazilian region. Through formulating and implementing effective HR strategies, ensure sufficient human resources support for the company's business operations in Brazil, maintain good employee relations, guarantee the compliance and high - efficiency of the company's HR management, and enhance the overall HR effectiveness.

Job Responsibilities

(1) Employee Relations Management

  1. Regularly conduct employee satisfaction surveys. Understand employees' satisfaction with HR and company management through questionnaires and other means, and strive to improve employee satisfaction.
  2. Actively handle labor disputes. Collaborate with the legal department to ensure the victory in labor lawsuits and avoid significant losses caused by losing cases.
  3. Ensure the efficient completion of probation - to - regular and contract renewal processes, and safeguard the compliance and stability of employees' employment relations.
  4. Strengthen employee compliance management. Promptly identify and correct employees' non - compliant behaviors, and reduce the situations where employees violate the company's interests and Brazilian labor laws.
  5. Monitor the turnover of key employees and strengthen the stability control of the workforce.

(2) Performance Management

  1. Regularly provide performance optimization suggestions that are recognized by business departments and approved by management to adapt the performance system to the business characteristics in Brazil.
  2. Ensure the performance processes are carried out as planned and avoid delaying employee incentives due to process delays.

(3) Training Management

Optimize training content to be in line with Brazilian regulations, job requirements, or employees' feedback. Ensure the optimization can be implemented as confirmed by business departments, and improve the pertinence and practicality of training.

(4) Business Support

  1. Regularly conduct talent inventory to clarify the company's human resources structure and support the talent allocation for the business expansion of the Brazilian subsidiary.
  2. Ensure the timely completion of salary surveys, make the salary strategy suitable for the local market level in Brazil, and enhance the company's talent competitiveness.
  3. Ensure the on - schedule progress of talent mapping work. Use talent maps to accurately locate target talents (such as those with scarce industry skills) and support the recruitment and reserve for key positions.
  4. Provide operational optimization suggestions from the perspective of HR management, identify optimization points in the operational processes (such as HR processes and cross - departmental collaboration) of the Brazilian subsidiary, and improve efficiency and reduce costs.

(5) Compensation Management

Liaise with payroll agencies and comprehensively manage salary payment matters for the company in Brazil. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of payroll data, including but not limited to the calculation and payment of employees' salaries, bonuses, and benefits. title: Business Partner
description:
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Buscamos um(a) Business Partner para atuar como elo entre cliente, gerente de projetos, equipe técnica e gestão interna.

O foco é garantir que requisitos sejam corretamente levantados, documentados, validados e entregues , mantendo alinhamento entre escopo formalizado, expectativa do cliente e execução técnica .

Esse papel é essencial para assegurar previsibilidade, qualidade e alinhamento na execução dos projetos , evitando desvios de escopo e retrabalho.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Levantar, especificar e documentar requisitos junto aos clientes, alinhados ao escopo e necessidades, de forma estruturada.
  • Formalizar requisitos e alinhar continuamente expectativa do cliente x escopo x execução técnica.
  • Participar de sprints e progress pulse junto ao time técnico, garantindo clareza sobre prioridades, status e bloqueios.
  • Validar internamente as entregas (homologação interna) frente aos requisitos levantados e ao escopo acordado.
  • Conduzir homologação externa com o cliente (apresentação e validação da entrega), sempre baseada no escopo, levantamento e especificação inicial.
  • Preparar formalizações de entregáveis e relatórios (com validação final do gerente).
  • Atuar como sentinela de escopo e qualidade : detectar e sinalizar desvios ao gerente de projetos.
  • Negociar prazos e expectativas em nível tático com clientes; conflitos de maior complexidade ou estratégicos são escalados ao gerente .
  • Garantir documentação de projeto (deck de gestão, cronograma macro, matriz de riscos, matriz de responsabilidades, status de backlog).
  • Consolidar dados de pipeline de projetos, prazos, throughput, retrabalho e CSAT.

INDICADORES DE SUCESSO (KPIs):

  • Qualidade e clareza dos requisitos levantados, refletida na ausência de gaps em homologação.
  • Percentual de entregas validadas sem retrabalho.
  • Percentual de entregas realizadas no prazo.
  • CSAT positivo dos clientes em relação ao processo de entrega e acompanhamento.
  • Projetos concluídos com documentação completa e aprovações formalizadas.

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em levantamento, análise e especificação de requisitos .
  • Noções de negócio a partir da análise de dados.
  • Habilidade em comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de negociação e gestão de conflitos em nível tático.
  • Experiência em projetos de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS) e conhecimento de processos de negócio.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Conhecimento em planejamento e gestão de tarefas.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.

MODELO DE TRABALHO:

  • Regime: PJ .
  • Modalidade: Remoto , com encontros presenciais esporádicos em Campinas/SP ou São Paulo/SP.

title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page !

Job Description

The professional will play a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be carried out by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and Improvement: Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Manage the project pipeline (PMO) and lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Collaborate on the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Implement and improve the “Long Term Capacity Planning” process, focusing on logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Manage the project pipeline (PMO) for the “Cost Efficiency Program.”
  • Lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, including:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Strong collaboration with Procurement and other stakeholders.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to ensure seamless logistics operations across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.
  • Lead initiatives to innovate and improve logistics strategies, ensuring adaptability to changing market conditions and customer demands.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to teams involved in logistics operations and strategic initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cost efficiency programs, including project pipeline management (PMO).
  • Expertise in identifying and implementing operational efficiency improvements and cost-saving initiatives.
  • Experience in applying process innovation to improve governance and operational performance.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (mandatory).

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Sr Technical Account Manager
description:
About Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a trusted partner in risk assessment, delivering data-driven solutions that help businesses accelerate growth, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer experience.

You’ll work within a collaborative and supportive environment to grow your personal and problem-solving skills and help deliver solutions that will go head-to-head against some of the most motivated attackers in the world to protect billions in revenue.

Collaborate with customers and account managers to maximize the value of the world’s leading email-based risk assessment solution, driving reduced fraud, lower friction, and increased profitability.

Key responsibilities include proactive account analysis, optimization of risk strategies, and delivering strategic insights during business reviews. The role requires a consultative mindset, strong analytical skills, and a focus on delivering measurable customer value.

You’ll work with real-time digital identity intelligence, analyzing millions of transactions monthly across major players in Financial Services, Insurance, and e-Commerce.

  • Share best practices, deliver internal training, and contribute to process optimization within Professional Services.
  • Drive customer success by fostering adoption, monitoring health metrics, and identifying upsell opportunities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience in payments, fraud, risk management or ecommerce industry.
  • 5+ years of client-facing experience, with a strong focus on risk mitigation strategies.
  • Proven track record in account management, client delivery, and complex project implementations.
  • Strong consultative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in statistics and data forensics.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships and drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Experienced in cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, and sales teams.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset, high integrity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Spanish is mandatory and advanced English is required.

Working for you

  • Hybrid work system

  • Health and dental plans
  • RECARES days for supporting charity

title: Lab Technician
description:
Are you our new Calibration Lab Technician with Maersk H2S Safety Services in Brazil?

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute calibration, functional tests, and adjustments on portable and fixed gas detectors.
  • Carry out Zero and Span adjustment procedures using certified and traceable standard gases.
  • Issue calibration certificates in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Ensure metrological traceability of results and maintain complete records of services performed.
  • Ensure the organization of the laboratory and suggest improvements in the process.
  • Follow the laboratory's calibration methods and procedures.
  • Periodically check the validity and integrity of reference standards.
  • Prepare technical reports and support internal and external audits.
  • Comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations throughout the calibration process.

We are looking for

  • Technical education in Instrumentation, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics and related areas.
  • Previous experience in calibration and maintenance of gas detectors.
  • Knowledge of metrology, traceability, and uncertainty assessment.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025 standards and Cgcre/Inmetro procedures.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals and manufacturer specifications.
  • Proficiency in technical documentation and issuance of calibration certificates.

Skills

  • Attention to detail and focus on accuracy.
  • Organization for deadline control and documentation.
  • Good communication for interaction with clients and support for audits.
  • Teamwork and adaptability to different types of sensors and environments.

Desired

  • Experience in an accredited ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory.
  • Courses or certifications in the field of industrial instrumentation and metrology.
  • Knowledge in the calibration of other instruments (pressure, temperature, etc.).
  • Technical English skills

Responsabilidades

  • Executar calibração, testes funcionais e ajustes em detectores de gás portáteis e fixos.
  • Realizar procedimentos de ajuste de Zero e Span, utilizando gases padrões certificados e rastreáveis.
  • Lançar certificados de calibração conforme requisitos da ISO/IEC 17025 e normas regulatórias aplicáveis.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade metrológica dos resultados e manter registros completos dos serviços realizados.
  • Garantir a organização do laboratório e indicar melhorias no processo.
  • Seguir o método de calibração e procedimentos do laboratório.
  • Verificar periodicamente a validade e integridade dos padrões de referência.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e apoiar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Cumprir normas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente durante todo o processo de calibração

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica em Instrumentação, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em calibração e manutenção de detectores de gases.
  • Conhecimento de metrologia, rastreabilidade e avaliação de incerteza.
  • Familiaridade com normas ISO/IEC 17025 e procedimentos da Cgcre/Inmetro.
  • Habilidade para interpretar manuais técnicos e especificações de fabricantes.
  • Domínio em documentação técnica e emissão de certificados de calibração.

Habilidades

  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em precisão.
  • Organização para controle de prazos e documentação.
  • Boa comunicação, para interação com clientes e suporte a auditorias.
  • Trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade a diferentes tipos de sensores e ambientes.

Desejado

  • Experiência em laboratório acreditado ISO/IEC 17025.
  • Cursos ou certificações na área de instrumentação industrial e metrologia.
  • Conhecimento em calibração de outros instrumentos (pressão, temperatura, etc.).
  • Inglês técnico.

title: Senior Software Engineer - LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
